meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在需要时载入一份高强度工作模式指令,让任务按该模式约定的规则推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 agent 切换到某个既定工作模式并按它的规则执行任务
copy.tagline_en: Load a high-intensity work-mode directive on demand so tasks follow that mode's rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the agent to switch into a defined work mode and follow its rules

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:首行输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分档,先注册目标与成功标准、开持久笔记本和 todo 清单,再用 curl、浏览器等真实界面跑证据验证才算完成。
howto.when: 当你请求 ultrawork 模式且该指令还不在对话中时接管;也适用于要求按目标与证据严格完成、并按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分档处理的编码任务。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug,给我真实界面的验证证据
say.note: 按 LIGHT 档定成功标准并跑真实界面证据。

say.text: 切到 ultrawork 模式,这个任务按 HEAVY 档处理
say.note: 启用审查循环直至无条件通过。

howto.what_en: Ultrawork mode makes Claude: print ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! as its first line; pick LIGHT or HEAVY; register a goal with success criteria; keep a notepad and todo list; and prove the change on real surfaces, not a green test suite.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for ultrawork mode and the directive is not already in the conversation; also for coding tasks you want run against goals and evidence with LIGHT/HEAVY sizing.

say_en.note: Prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! and runs bootstrap.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode and give me real-surface evidence
say_en.note: Sizes as LIGHT, sets criteria, captures real-surface proof.

say_en.text: Switch to ultrawork mode and treat this task as HEAVY
say_en.note: Adds the reviewer loop until unconditional approval.
